fusions.name: Shed Layer
fusions.desc: Bursts a layer of bark plate off your body 3 tiles ahead of you; it deals 8 piercing damage to everything caught in it. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Pavise Slam
fusions.desc: Slams a plank shield into the target that deals 13 damage, stuns it for 1.4 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Cambium Plate
fusions.desc: Grows a fresh layer of bark under your plate that absorbs the next 24 damage, up to 5 blows, for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Cork Hide
fusions.desc: Conjures a cuirass of cork bark: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12%, your maximum health rises by 10, and 6% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
